name: Create Durable User from Passkey Proof
summary: Creates one durable user only after passkey attestation is verified and identity-resolution policy permits creation.

preconditions.expression: pending-identity-status == resolution-required and credential-proof == passkey-proved and durable-identity == creation-required

setup: Confirm no existing canonical identity matches the pending passkey identity.

postconditions.expression: durable-identity == resolved and account-status == active and home-workspace == required and pending-identity-status == resolution-required
